label: AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds (Tobias et al. 2022), figshare 16586228 version 7
governance: Peer-reviewed data paper in Ecology Letters (Tobias et al. 2022, 25:581-597; DOI resolves, checked 2026-10-31) with the data deposited on figshare under a DataCite DOI. Licence on the figshare record: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Measurements are primary specimen measurements taken by the author consortium (museum skins, live birds), with per-measurer and per-source sheets in the workbook.
versioning: figshare versions 1-7; version 7 published 2022-12-05T16:56:26Z (api.figshare.com). Version-specific DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.16586228.v7. File 34480856 'AVONET Supplementary dataset 1.xlsx' (21,524,673 bytes, figshare md5 1445afdcfb6df784010c2ca034544bc8) contains sheet AVONET1_BirdLife with 11,009 species rows and 37 columns (re-derived 2026-10-31).
known_issues: Vendored records disagree on the 'issued' date: the article was published 2022-02-24 (paper) while figshare v7 is dated 2022-12-05; records giving '2022-02' or '2022' describe the paper, not the deposit.
Some records quote the un-versioned DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.16586228 (resolves to the latest version) rather than the v7 DOI they actually downloaded.
Species names follow BirdLife taxonomy (AVONET1 sheet); genera that differ in the project's accepted names (e.g. Coloeus monedula vs Corvus monedula) are present under the BirdLife name.
rationale: AVONET is a peer-reviewed, DOI-versioned dataset of primary morphological measurements with explicit licensing and a documented file inventory, so all three source-level scores are near the top of the scale. The only deductions reflect figshare's un-versioned DOI alias and taxonomy differences, which are handled at record level. Every URL, DOI, md5 and row count cited here was re-verified on 2026-10-31.
